config.name: GIS-Based Flood Susceptibility Screening Index
config.output: relative screening score 0-100 (NOT a flood probability, hazard, depth or extent)

normalization.note: Scaled relative to the study area itself; scores are only comparable within one run.

categories.note: Equal-count quintiles: 'Very high' always contains ~20% of cells by construction. Categories are relative ranks, not absolute hazard classes.

variables.name: rel_elev_mean_m
variables.label: Local relative elevation
variables.rationale: Cells lower than their ~1 km surroundings collect runoff (topographic wetness proxy).

variables.name: elev_mean_m
variables.label: Absolute elevation
variables.rationale: Lower parts of the catchment are generally more flood-prone than ridges and plateaus.

variables.name: slope_mean_deg
variables.label: Mean slope
variables.rationale: Flat terrain drains slowly and ponds water.

variables.name: dist_waterway_m
variables.label: Distance to mapped waterway
variables.rationale: Proximity to rivers/streams/canals raises riverine overflow susceptibility. OSM omits many culverted nallahs.

variables.name: builtup_share
variables.label: Built-up land-cover share
variables.rationale: Built-up cover reduces infiltration (land-cover proxy only; not measured imperviousness).

excluded_variables.name: flow_accumulation
excluded_variables.reason: Requires hydrologically conditioned DEM (pit filling, burn-in of channels); not implemented. Not substituted.

excluded_variables.name: rainfall
excluded_variables.reason: Static screening index does not model rainfall-runoff; rainfall is shown as context only.

config.weights_status: Expert-judgement priors from flood-susceptibility literature; NOT calibrated against observations. See sensitivity analysis.

elev_mean_m.label: Mean elevation
elev_mean_m.method: Mean of 30 m DSM pixels in cell

slope_mean_deg.label: Mean slope
slope_mean_deg.method: Mean of np.gradient slope on 30 m UTM DSM

rel_elev_mean_m.label: Relative elevation
rel_elev_mean_m.method: Pixel minus mean in 1 km square window, averaged over cell

builtup_share.label: Built-up land-cover share
builtup_share.method: Share of 10 m pixels with class 50

population_sum.label: Population (WorldPop)
population_sum.method: Sum of pixel values with centre in cell; modelled, not census

dist_waterway_m.label: Distance to nearest mapped waterway
dist_waterway_m.method: Centroid-to-line distance in UTM; OSM waterway completeness unverified

road_length_m.label: Mapped road length
road_length_m.method: Length of OSM road segments clipped to cell, in UTM

flow_accumulation.label: Flow accumulation
flow_accumulation.reason: not implemented (needs pit-filled DEM and validated channel network)

limitations: Relative screening score, not a flood probability, hazard, depth or inundation extent
Weights are expert-judgement priors, not calibrated against observed floods
Elevation is a surface model (buildings/canopy included) at 30 m
Waterway layer from OSM omits many culverted channels
Scores comparable only within this run (percentile-normalised)
mean_contribution_note: Averaged over all scored cells; an absent input contributes 0 to that cell's sum, so contributions sum exactly to the mean score.
